scripts.test: bun run test:deploy && bun run --filter '*' --if-present test && cd apps/realtime-gateway && go test ./...
scripts.test:deploy: export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; bash scripts/deploy/compose_release_test.sh && bash scripts/deploy/deploy_contract_test.sh && python3 scripts/deploy/wss_smoke_test.py && bash scripts/deploy/container_test.sh
scripts.build: bun run --filter '*' --if-present build && cd apps/realtime-gateway && mkdir -p dist && go build -o dist/realtime-gateway ./cmd/gateway
scripts.check: bun run check:deploy && bun run --filter '*' --if-present check && cd apps/realtime-gateway && go vet ./...
scripts.check:deploy: ruff check scripts/deploy/*.py && actionlint && shellcheck scripts/deploy/*.sh && bash -n scripts/deploy/*.sh
